summary: Wheels Up Experience Inc. filed an 8-K regarding Amendment No. 4 to the Investment and Investor Rights Agreement with Delta Air Lines and other lead lenders. The amendment extends the lock-up restriction on approximately 35.6% of the company's outstanding shares held by Delta until May 22, 2027, and aligns the deadline for filing a shelf registration statement to the same date for Delta, with a conditional earlier date for CIH. This is a contractual extension with no immediate transaction impact; no board recommendation or advisors were noted. The filing primarily addresses share transfer restrictions and registration rights, not a special situation event. Watch for any future shareholder actions or registration triggers.
